description: Search active freight loads (cargo looking for a truck) on Ariberi. Give from_city, to_city or both. Returns route, cargo, body type, weight, price if stated, road distance, loading date, posting time and a url of the load on ariberi.com (the shipper's phone opens there after sign-in). Newest first.

body.description: Truck body type: tent (curtainsider), reefer, tandem (drawbar combination), flatbed, lowbed (low-loader), car carrier. Russian names also accepted.

from_city.description: Loading city, e.g. Khorgos / Хоргос, Almaty, Alashankou

to_city.description: Unloading city, e.g. Tashkent / Ташкент, Moscow

name: search_loads
title: Search truck loads
